title: TTOM 2026 Route Map — Ultra Marathon (56 km), Chappies
claims: The PDF linked from the official 2027 Ultra Marathon page as 'Download Map' is headed '56KM ULTRA' and carries the TOTALSPORTS TWO OCEANS MARATHON, powered by BYD branding.

The sheet maps the 56 km route from the Newlands main-road start to the Rondebosch finish, with kilometre markers to 54 km, hydration, food and medical stations, and inset maps for Noordhoek and the Canterbury Drive area.
An elevation profile across the foot of the sheet runs from 5 km to 56 km on the horizontal axis and from 3 m to 242 m on the vertical axis.

The file is a static PDF map of the 2026 edition, not a GPX, KML or GeoJSON track, and carries no stated reuse licence; the official 2027 page still says a detailed 2027 route map will be made available before the race.

verification.note: 2026-11-21 下载并逐页读取官方 PDF（1 页，6,213,932 字节，HTTP Last-Modified 2026-03-12）：标题 '56KM ULTRA'，含 56 公里路线、公里标记、补给/医疗站、两处放大图与底部海拔剖面。该 PDF 由官方 2027 Ultra 页的 'Download Map' 直接链接；它是 2026 届静态图，不是 2027 路线图，也不是 GPX。
